descriptionChirho: A physical door or gate of a building, room, city, or sacred structure; the movable barrier that closes an opening in a wall or entrance.
A column or section of a written scroll or document, as in the columns of a scroll that are cut and burned (Jeremiah 36:23).
A lid or cover used to close the opening of a vessel or container, distinguished from a door by its context of covering an object rather than an entrance.
